items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: That's the booker. He was the booker, and this Lee Krauss.

ctx.x: That must have been number two, but they had two orchestras left, but the Dixalan, you remember, bro, used to put that livery stable blue? Yeah, the rocker. Yeah, the rocker and shield. Yeah. Yeah, the ritual. They're still written in there. They had a colored man, Manuel Perez, all that was up there for them. These men, is it Mitchell Lacalze, C-A-L-Z-I?

That's the booker. He was the booker, and this Lee Krauss. Krauss, that's two partners. Two partners. They're the ones that booked you. That's correct. Into the deluxe. That's right. Yeah, that's so nice. We saw Louis Capard, have you seen him lately?
No, I've seen him something like that. I haven't seen him in 1919.
